theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic zero, B a locally Noetherian k-scheme (or locally Noetherian algebraic k-stack with a smooth atlas), pi:C->B smooth proper with geometrically connected genus-6 fibres, and gamma:C->P^1_B finite flat of degree 4 whose Casnati-Ekedahl relations bundle is fibrewise balanced, F_b iso O(4) direct-sum O(5). Let 0->W_4->W->W_5->0 be the canonical filtration of ATT-0065/CLM-0065-5 (dual-confirmed by REV-0108 and REV-0109), L:=W_5 tensor omega_{C/B}^{-1}, M:=omega_{C/B}^{tensor 2} tensor W_5^vee, I:=Hilb^6(C/B) x_{Pic^6(C/B)} B the Abel-Jacobi incidence over [L], I^dist its distinct-support open, and Z_ev:=Conf_6(C/B) x_{Hilb^6(C/B)} I the ordered incidence of ATT-0066/(H4) (dual-confirmed by REV-0110 and REV-0116). Assume, exactly as in the dependency package and not proved here: (N) the fibrewise weak CE relative-canonical normalization O_{P(E_b^vee)}(1)|_{C_b} iso omega_{C_b/P^1} tensor gamma_b^*A_b; and (R) the fibrewise CE ideal has the standard degree-four resolution 0->O_X(-4) tensor p^*det F->O_X(-2) tensor p^*F->I_C->0 on X=Proj_{P^1}(Sym E) with p_*O_X(1)=E. Then, with every dimension taken componentwise and relative to B (no absolute dimension of B is asserted): (A) every geometric fibre C_b is neither hyperelliptic nor a smooth plane quintic; (B) consequently h^0(O_{C_b}(D_b))=2 and h^0(L_b)=3 for every geometric point b, so B_4={h^0(L)=4} is empty, and over reduced B one has pi_*L locally free of rank 3 with base change and I iso P((pi_*L)^vee) a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle over all of B, smooth and proper of pure relative dimension 2, with irreducible components the preimages of those of B and of dimension dim(component of B)+2; (C) |L_b| is base-point-free on every geometric fibre, hence in characteristic zero its reduced-support locus is a dense open of |L_b| iso P^2, so I^dist is dense open in I, meets every geometric fibre, surjects onto B, has the same components and dimensions as B, and Z_ev->I^dist is a finite etale S_6-torsor at stack level, nonempty over every geometric point of B and equidimensional of the same dimension; (D) over reduced B the universal degree-six divisor script-D subset C x_B I is finite locally free of degree 6 over I, etale exactly over I^dist, and equals the Zariski-locally trivial P^1-bundle P(K^vee) over C with K:=ker(pi^*pi_*L->L) locally free of rank 2, so components of script-D match those of B; if B is irreducible then script-D, I and I^dist are irreducible, the etale monodromy rho:pi_1^et(I^dist)->S_6 has transitive image G, and Z_ev has exactly [S_6:G] irreducible components each finite etale of degree |G| over I^dist; (E) for every geometric b exactly one of the following holds for phi_{L_b}:C_b->P^2 given by the complete base-point-free g^2_6 |L_b|: (i) birational onto a plane sextic of arithmetic genus 10 with total delta-invariant 4; (ii) 2:1 onto a smooth plane cubic (bielliptic, L_b=p_b^*N_b with deg N_b=3); or (iii) 3:1 onto a smooth conic (trigonal, L_b=2T_b); and in case (i) the six-point monodromy over |L_b|^dist is 2-transitive, hence primitive, so the rank-6 rational permutation local system splits as Q direct-sum an irreducible of rank 5; (F) if (C,gamma,Gamma) is a geometric point of Z_ev whose ordered reduced Gamma has at least three distinct gamma-images and at least one unramified point, then Aut(C,gamma,Gamma)=1 and Aut(C,gamma,Gamma)->Aut(C,Gamma) is an isomorphism; moreover on every geometric fibre the reduced Gamma in |L_b| failing either condition form a proper closed subset (all-points-ramified is finite; at-most-two-images has dimension at most 1, using h^0(O(3D) tensor omega^{-1})<=1 from (A)), so the trivial-stabilizer locus is dense open in every geometric fibre of Z_ev->B; (G) for every geometric point of Z_ev one has omega_C(-Gamma) iso O_C(D) with h^0=2, so |omega_C(-Gamma)| is the complete base-point-free pencil defining gamma and gamma is recovered from (C,Gamma) up to Aut(P^1); consequently the classifying map on geometric points to M_{6,6} has singleton geometric fibres, unconditionally because B_4 is empty. No assertion is made about irreducibility of B, absolute dimension of B or of any image in M_{6,6}, whether G equals S_6, whether cases (E)(ii)-(iii) occur on the balanced locus, monomorphism or full faithfulness on families, quasi-finiteness as a stack morphism, closedness/non-closedness/codimension of the forgetful image, lci/Gysin/purity, or any Hodge/weight/Tate conclusion.
